# Civic

> Agents call Civic, not tools directly. One secure URL gives any AI agent scoped access to 100+ tools, with runtime guardrails, audit logs, and instant revocation. Set up in ten minutes, no procurement cycle.

## Core
- [Civic](https://www.civic.com/md/index.md): Agents, by Civic. Not an add-on. It's how we build.
- [Docs](https://docs.civic.com): Integration guides, SDK references, and setup docs for Civic.
- [About](https://www.civic.com/md/about.md): The team and mission behind Civic.
- [Content](https://www.civic.com/md/content.md): All Civic content in one place: articles, podcasts, videos, and news.
- [Agent Skills](https://www.civic.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Installable skills for AI coding agents. Setup guides, integration recipes, and PRD generation. Fetch the index for the full catalog.
